description: Calculates and locks the wholesale statement for one closed calendar month (UTC) from the agency's billable client intervals. Requires the agency owner. Freezing the same month again returns the same period; it does not charge.

end.description: First instant of the following UTC month (ISO date-time).

start.description: First instant of the closed UTC month (ISO date-time).

name: agency_billing_freeze_period
title: Freeze Wholesale Billing Period
